title: Week 8 Practice: Mixed Review Warm-Up
description: Use this as a mixed warm-up before the final weekly simulation.

questions.question: The sum of two consecutive integers is 21. What is the larger integer?
questions.explanation: Let them be $x$ and $x+1$. Then $2x+1=21$, so $x=10$ and the larger is 11.

questions.question: A shirt worth 800 pesos is discounted by 25%. What is the sale price?
questions.explanation: Discount is 200, so the new price is 600.
